title: tectaria ridleyana
intro: Tectaria ridleyana, commonly known as Ridley's tectaria fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Tectaria ridleyana include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
